inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is demanding that we reject the proposed constitutional amendments aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. He criticized these measures at a press conference. Some are trying to dismiss this as an attack on established authority and national stability that invites division, insisting strong continuous leadership upholds social order and traditional ways. In truth, this is a vital resistance to the ruling structures trying to lock in power for the few, which has long deepened inequality and left vulnerable groups exposed to unchecked exploitation and discrimination. We need to back these efforts for real institutional reform that centers labor rights and protects the marginalized instead of letting elites extend their control.
